pages.title: Issues - Andy Barr for Senate
pages.text:
## Andy Believes...
Andy Barr believes we must deport all criminal illegals and secure the border. Andy voted for the largest border security bill in history that sent record resources to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to seal our border in 2025. When Joe Biden opened our borders to millions of illegal immigrants, he voted to impeach Biden’s DHS Secretary for failing to enforce our border security laws. Andy received the endorsement of the National Border Patrol Council and has a perfect, A+ rating from NumbersUSA, the top border security advocacy group in the country. Andy has consistently fought for policies such as:
- Restarting border wall construction
- Funding to hire more border agents
- Reinstating the Remain in Mexico policy
- Ending catch and release
Andy will always fight to keep our border secure.
Charles Booker will raise taxes on every Kentuckian, Andy Barr wants to cut taxes for every Kentuckian. Andy has always fought for tax cuts. In 2025, he voted for the largest tax cut in American history, the Big Beautiful Bill. The average Kentucky family with two kids saves $4,200 under the new tax law that Andy helped author, champion, and push through Congress.
The Big Beautiful Bill ended taxes on Social Security for seniors, taxes on overtime for Kentucky workers, and tips for Kentucky’s great waiters and waitresses. Andy also championed the Made in America tax credit that helped secure a $1B investment from Apple into the Corning manufacturing plant in Harrodsburg, Kentucky. This investment doubles jobs at the plant, where all the iPhone and AppleWatch glass will now be produced.
As the father of three daughters, Andy has long defended girls’ sports and private spaces from the radical trans movement. He’s leading the Defend Girls’ Athletics Act that cuts off federal funding to any school or university that refuses to uphold the ban on biological men in girls’ sports. He supported and voted for legislation banning sex change operations on minors. His work protecting our girls led him to receive the endorsement of Riley Gaines. Andy has been clear, there are two genders – God given, not doctor altered – and there should be no men in girls’ sports, locker rooms, or bathrooms.
Andy Barr has led the fight for our veterans, passing the Veterans Fairness and Transparency Act, ensuring our veterans had access to key disability benefits when federal offices shuttered during the COVID-19 pandemic.
To help our veterans transition to successful civilian careers, Andy championed the Veteran STEM Scholarship Enhancement Act into law. This law boosted science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) scholarships for veterans.
Most recently, Andy ushered through Congress legislation giving veterans more access to non-VA provided healthcare options.
Andy created the Veterans for Barr Coalition, a group of volunteer veterans and advocates who come together to advise him on veterans issues. Andy Barr will always take care of our veterans.
Kentucky Energy Powers America
No one fought Biden’s war on energy more than Andy Barr. Andy has a plan to bring back clean, beautiful coal, to create jobs, lower energy costs, and attract industries of the future to Kentucky. You can read his plan for Kentucky coal here.
Andy’s work to unleash Kentucky energy doesn’t end with coal. The first veto of Joe Biden’s presidency was a bill Andy wrote to block Biden’s environmental, social, and governance (ESG) mandates to protect Americans’ retirement accounts and 401(k)s. And when Biden tried to backdoor the Green New Deal through financial regulators like the Federal Reserve and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Andy Barr held the line.
When the Radical Left comes for your firearm or to impose more restrictions on law-abiding gun owners, Andy will stand in the breach and fight for our Second Amendment rights. Andy has consistently opposed gun control bills put forward to strip gun owners of their firearms without due process.
Andy also led the Fair Access to Banking Act, which prohibits banks from discriminating against the firearms industry.
In the last Congress, Andy had a perfect A+ voting record from the National Shooting Sports Foundation. Andy also proudly received endorsements in the past from the National Rifle Association and Gun Owners of America.
No one will work harder as your next U.S. Senator to protect your Second Amendment Rights from every possible threat.
Andy Barr is leading the charge against the CCP. Andy led the STOP Chinese Fentanyl Act into law, which sanctions anyone involved in China with fentanyl manufacturing. The Drug Enforcement Administration estimates that half of fentanyl comes from China. That poison is killing Kentuckians every year and Andy Barr won’t stand for it.
Andy also succeeded in passing a law that cuts off American investment into Chinese military, surveillance, and technology companies.
While Charles Booker wants to defund the police and abolish cash-bail, Andy Barr strongly supports police and will work with them to help keep Kentucky safe. Andy has been endorsed in his past campaigns by the Kentucky Fraternal Order of Police and has voted to increase federal funding to support law enforcement throughout Kentucky.
To help our police attack the fentanyl and overdose crisis, Andy fought for additional federal resources to help local communities with drug enforcement, prevention efforts, and rehabilitation for people struggling with addiction. Andy also worked to get the STOP Chinese Fentanyl Act signed into law that sanctions anyone involved in fentanyl production in China. The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) estimates half of the fentanyl found in the U.S. is sourced from China.
You can read more about how Andy has supported law enforcement here.
Food doesn’t come from the grocery store, it comes from the hardworking men and women who have worked on Kentucky’s great farms for generations. Andy Barr is committed to fighting for Kentucky’s farmers to ensure that they have the support they need to feed our communities and keep our Commonwealth healthy.
Andy delivered the largest tax cut in history to farmers, ending the death tax on 2 million family farms and expanding crop insurance to record levels. Now, Andy is leading the charge to undo the ban on Kentucky’s hemp industry. Andy is fighting to establish a federal regulatory framework for hemp-derived consumer products while protecting Kentucky farmers, enhancing consumer safety, and preserving the long-term viability of the domestic hemp industry.

pages.title: Military and Veterans - Andy Barr for Senate
pages.text:
## Andy Barr: Kentucky's Champion for Military, National Guard, and Veterans
To our military heroes,
We need a Senator who will hit the ground running for the 50,000
active-duty servicemembers and 300,000 veterans who call Kentucky home.
Kentucky’s servicemembers, National Guardsmen, and veterans deserve more
than rhetoric — they deserve results. Congressman Andy Barr has delivered.
Just listen to retired Marine Corporal and American hero Matthew Bradford,
Andy Barr takes care of veterans and always will.
Kentucky has played a pivotal role in our military history. From Private Franklin
Sousley raising the flag at Iwo Jima to the 60 Kentuckians who have been
awarded the nation’s Medal of Honor to the men and women serving at Fort
Knox, Fort Campbell, and other installations across the Commonwealth.
Now is not the time to have a Senator who needs on-the-job training, now
is the time to put Andy Barr in the Senate so that he can fight for those who
have fought for us.
## Fighting for Higher Pay
- Barr has supported and voted for annual military pay raises for troops, including the FY2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), which included a historic 14.5% pay raise for enlisted troops.
## Expanding Healthcare Access
- Barr cosponsored and voted for the Blue Water Navy
Vietnam Veterans Act of 2019. This law extended healthcare benefits for military members exposed to Agent Orange and other toxins while serving on ships during the Vietnam War.
- Barr cosponsored and voted for the PACT Act, the federal law that extended VA disability benefits to veterans of the Global War on Terrorism who were exposed to burn pit and other toxins during their service.
## Standing with Kentucky's Guard & Military
- Strong supporter of the Kentucky National Guard and its federal mission. Barr received the Charles Dick Medal of Merit, the highest distinction for lawmakers in advocating for the Guard.
- Led the charge to bring C130-Js to the Kentucky National Guard.
## Fighting for Mental Health Benefits
- Voted for the 2024 landmark Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Health and Benefits Improvement Act that enhanced disability claims processes, expanded veterans choice, and strengthened accountability on the VA.
- VA disability claims were processed faster in 2025 than any other year before and the backlog of VA disability claims fell by 37%.
- Championed the passage of Equine Assisted Therapy and the allotment of $5M for providers nationwide.
## Strengthening Education & Transition Benefits
- Led bipartisan amendments to the Edith Nourse Rogers STEM Scholarship under the Forever GI Bill—signed into law by President Trump—that lowered credit hour requirements, expanded access for student veterans, and helped Kentucky veterans complete their degrees while strengthening our STEM workforce.

pages.text:
## Andy Barr: I Will Always Back the Blue
Dear Law Enforcement Heroes,
You deserve leaders who have your back — not just when it’s politically popular, but when it really counts. Throughout my time in Congress, I have been proud to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with
Kentucky’s law enforcement officers. You are the front line between order and chaos, and I will always fight to ensure you have the support, funding, and respect you deserve.
Unlike my opponents in this race, I will never cave to the radical left when they come for our men and women in uniform with anti police, pro-criminal policies that will hurt our law enforcement and endanger our communities.
## Here is my Record of Supporting Law Enforcement:
- Championing the Chief Herbert D. Proffitt Act: to fix the Public Safety Officers’ Benefits program so that families of fallen officers aren’t denied benefits due to retirement technicalities. Chief Proffitt, a Kentuckian killed by a criminal he once put behind bars, deserves justice — and so do all of you who wear the badge. I led this bill to passage in Congress and it will be signed into law by President Donald Trump.
- Social Security Fairness Act: supported and voted for the Social Security Fairness Act to repeal unfair provisions that reduce Social Security benefits for police officers, firefighters, and other public servants. You paid into the system — you earned those benefits. It’s time the law treated you fairly.
- Expanding High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area (HIDTA) designations: enhanced HIDTA designations in the Sixth District — including Clark, Madison, Montgomery, and Powell Counties — so local and state law enforcement could access enhanced federal resources, intelligence sharing, and coordination tools to fight fentanyl and organized crime.
- Fighting for COPS and DOJ Grants: I’ve secured millions in Department of Justice and COPS Office grants to strengthen local departments across Central and Eastern Kentucky — including hiring funds, new technology, and school safety upgrades to protect officers and students.
- Enhancing Criminal Penalties for Criminals who Target Cops: I voted for the Thin Blue Line Act and the Protect and Serve Act — legislation to strengthen penalties for anyone who assaults or targets police officers. Criminals who attack law enforcement must face serious consequences.
## The Contrast Couldn't Be Clearer:
Unfortunately, not everyone in this race shares my respect for the men and women who wear the uniform.
- Nate Morris Supported BLM: while serving as CEO of Rubicon Technologies — publicly supported the Black Lives Matter movement. The official BLM platform calls for defunding and abolishing police departments, ending qualified immunity, and advancing other anti-law enforcement policies. BLM torched the city of Louisville during the 2020 riots over Breonna Taylor. They caused property damage, vandalism, and assaulted police officers. Anyone who promoted them should be disqualified from being the GOP nominee.
- Daniel Cameron Pushed for Pro-Criminal Cashless Bail: while serving as spokesman for the radical group “Kentucky Smart on Crime,” Cameron called for the elimination of cash bail. “We have right now a bail system that’s a money bail system. We want to move to a no-money bail system,” Cameron said. This far-left policy has led to the deaths of countless of Americans murdered by criminals who are released into the streets by pro-criminal politicians that make cops’ jobs harder.
Kentucky’s law enforcement community deserves a Senator who doesn’t just talk about backing the blue — but has done it, consistently. My record is clear: I have fought for you in Congress, and I will fight for you in the U.S. Senate. Together, we can ensure that public safety remains a top priority and that every officer in Kentucky receives the respect, resources, and protection they deserve.
Thank you for your service and sacrifice.
